newsitem.title: UK: Croda says to pay 40 mln stg for French grp.
newsitem.headline: Croda says to pay 40 mln stg for French grp.

text.p: British speciality chemicals group Croda International said on Wednesday it was buying STOA S.A. Group of companies of France for 40 million stg, payable in cash.
The British group said it will also take over debt of nine million stg in STOA.
The acquisition, to be financed from the group's existing resources, is expected to further strengthen Croda's oleochemical business.

One of STOA's, Sederma S.A., is involved in the development and sale of active ingredients of skincare and will complement Croda's existing haircare business, the other main personal care market segment.
STOA reported pre-tax profits of 3.5 million stg in 1996 and had net assets, excluding debt of 3.4 million stg.
Croda's chairman Michael Valentine said that even on the basis of Sederma's existing businesses, the acquisition would enhance the group's earnings from the outset.
